claim: The CLI writes one self-contained HTML review copy with search, CSV download, and source-hash provenance.
sandbox: generate a bounded, correlated artifact from shipped sample data; open it from file: and exercise rows, search, source hash, normal CSV, and formula-leading CSV cells

claim: Default rules replace email addresses, bearer tokens, common secret fields including OAuth tokens, authorization, credentials, sessions, cookies, and private keys, plus AKIA or ASIA AWS access-key IDs.
where: landing hero, landing action, catalog description, README redaction section
sandbox: generate a browser-visible artifact containing client_secret, refresh_token, id_token, private_key, Basic authorization, session, cookie, prefix/suffix variants, and structured JSON fields; assert every raw secret is absent from the file and rendered view

claim: The CLI never overwrites an existing output file and rejects output paths that resolve to an input file.
sandbox: use direct, hard-link, and symbolic-link aliases plus an unrelated existing output; assert nonzero exits and byte-identical source and output contents

claim: The CLI reads a chosen file or standard input.
where: landing facts, how it works, README
sandbox: run the CLI once with a named sample file and once with the same record on stdin; assert both artifacts contain exactly one record and the correct source

claim: RFC 3339 time bounds select the initial window, then correlation includes matching trace records outside it.
sandbox: run the shipped sample with a two-second window and trace_id correlation; assert six linked records and no unrelated health check

claim: A local label=regex file adds redaction rules.
sandbox: write a temporary local rule file; generate an artifact; assert its matching customer ID is replaced with the named marker

claim: Generated review copies list the default and supplied local redaction-rule labels.
sandbox: generate a review with one local customer-id rule; open the artifact and assert the provenance lists the five default labels and the supplied label

claim: The browser demo uses six fixed sample records in memory and writes no demo data to browser storage.
where: demo banner, privacy page, README, demo documentation
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; search and reset; assert same-origin requests and empty local/session storage

claim: Site pages load runtime files only from the product website.
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit home, demo, privacy, and terms while recording every request origin

claim: The website has no log upload or account feature.
sandbox: fresh browser context; inspect home and privacy for file inputs, forms, sign-in, registration, and account affordances; assert every request is GET

claim: The site provides a copyable command to install the CLI from its public source repository.
where: landing action, install section, demo banner
sandbox: fresh browser context; follow the landing Install the CLI and demo Start for real links; assert the stable Cargo source-install command and repository link are visible

claim: The browser demo downloads all six sample records as CSV.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; download and inspect the CSV header and six records

claim: The browser demo searches its six redacted sample records and restores them when the search is cleared.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; search for ledger, assert one matching record, clear the search, and assert all six records return

claim: The browser demo shows email and bearer-token redaction markers in its sample records.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert the two named redaction markers are visible in the sample record rows

claim: The sample records show one confirmed charge after retry and duplicate_charge=false.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; inspect the ledger and final payment records, then assert the matching sample conclusion is visible

claim: The CLI demo creates the six-record correlated checkout review in a private, unique temporary directory without reusing files or symlinks.
sandbox: place a hostile symlink at the legacy shared path; run --demo twice with an isolated temporary root; assert unique private directories, unchanged victim bytes, and a working generated artifact

claim: The landing page ships a self-hosted terminal recording captured from the packaged CLI demo.
where: landing terminal recording, README demo section
sandbox: generate the recording from a freshly cargo-packaged and installed CLI demo; assert byte equality with the shipped SVG and load it from the landing page

claim: The CLI creates a finite review copy, not a live log service.
sandbox: run the demo command with a timeout; assert it exits with a six-record file and exposes no server, watch, listen, or tail option

claim: The CLI and companion site are MIT licensed, with no paid tier or purchase flow.
sandbox: read the shipped LICENSE; inspect home and terms; assert no checkout link exists

claim: The static deployment config defines security headers, immutable hashed assets, route rewrites, and a real 404 page.
sandbox: parse the shipped Static Web Apps config and assert framing protection, immutable asset caching, known routes, and the 404 override
